migrationNotes: Initial Devtools deploy manifest created from the central PoloSaaS Coolify template on 2026-05-09.
No Coolify staging resources are declared or approved for autonomous deploy yet; stg.enabled remains false and deploymentStatus is not_ready.
The repo currently has apps/web, apps/api and apps/worker packages, but root Dockerfile.web, Dockerfile.api and Dockerfile.worker are missing.
API exposes /health, /api/v1/health, /api/v1/app/manifest, /api/v1/session/context, /api/v1/audit/events and /api/v1/usage; web/worker staging healthchecks still need deployable container contracts.
Staging PostgreSQL must use the shared platform-postgres-stg resource on state-stg-01, database polosaas_stg, app-owned schema devtools. Do not create a devtools-db-stg resource.

Runtime defaults to Postgres for API_STORE_MODE, but staging cutover is not proven and artifact storage still defaults to local development storage; do not claim full stateless staging compliance until object storage and worker/job recovery are verified.
Experience context, shell_embed=content, tenant skins and template-pack support are not complete enough to mark experienceContext=true.

A future ready manifest should declare devtools-web-stg on edge-fe-01, devtools-api-stg on api-stg-01 and devtools-worker-stg on state-stg-01 only after Dockerfiles, env, healthchecks and smoke checks exist.
